instruction: In Music, where is the music progress bar? Please help me open POSPERITY in Music, then drag the progress bar to 0:10 and stop there. I want to see how you operate it.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Music" to get player position' 2>/dev/null | awk '{if($1 > 5 && $1 < 16) print "True"; else print "False"}'
